meta.name: Send daily WhatsApp task reminders from Google Sheets via WAHA

name: Daily WhatsApp reminders for tasks due today

parameters.content:
## 1. Build today's reminders
Each afternoon the sheet is read for tasks due today. Finished tasks are dropped, and the rest are grouped so each person gets one message listing all their tasks.

## 2. Send one message per person
Assignees are handled one at a time. The reminder goes out through your WhatsApp API, then the task IDs in that message are listed for tracking.

## 3. Record the follow-up
Every task that was reminded about has its follow-up count increased in the sheet, with a short pause between writes.

# Daily WhatsApp reminders for tasks due today

Every afternoon this reads your task sheet, finds everything due today that is not finished yet, and sends each person a single WhatsApp message listing their tasks. It then records that a reminder went out, so you can see who has been chased and how often.

### How it works
1. A schedule fires each afternoon and a config node holds your WhatsApp API details.
2. Tasks are read from the sheet, filtered to today's due date, and anything already completed or closed is dropped.
3. A Code node groups the remaining tasks by assignee and writes one message per person. Someone with three tasks gets one message listing all three, not three separate pings.
4. Assignees are handled one at a time and the message is sent through your WhatsApp API, with clear instructions to reply to the message with an update.
5. The task IDs covered by that message are listed, and each one has its follow-up count increased by one in the sheet.
6. A short pause between writes keeps the run inside the Sheets API limits.

### Setup
1. Connect your Google Sheets account and replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your own sheet, containing a Task tab.
2. The Task tab needs columns for Task ID, Assigned_To, Assignee_WhatsApp, Task_Details, Due_Date, Status and Count_no._of_FollowUp.
3. Open Set config and fill in your WAHA server address, API key, session name, and the country code to prefix on assignee numbers.
4. Due dates must be stored in the same format the trigger looks for, for example 05 Apr 2026.

### Customization
Change the trigger hour, or edit the status values in Keep unfinished tasks to match your own sheet.
